falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the primary equity index (SPX) closes at a new 63-day high and remains above that high for 3 consecutive sessions, while the share of S&P 500 members above their 50-day moving average rises by at least 5 percentage points from today.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Price and breadth resolved as a continuation breakout, so a HOLD/UNKNOWN call tied to an unresolved mini-top analog was wrong; the correct stance was risk-on, not hold.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days SPX closes 4% or more below its rolling 20-day high on a day when VIX also closes at or above 22.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The setup already resolved into a confirmed risk-off break, so HOLD/UNKNOWN was wrong; the correct call was to cut risk rather than wait.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the US 10-year yield rises at least 25 basis points from its lowest close in the prior 14 days, high-yield OAS tightens by at least 25 basis points over the same window, and SPX still prints a higher high versus today's close.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The June 2019 mini-top analog (growth-scare, duration bid, stalled risk) failed; a rates-up, credit-tightening advance invalidates both the 75% pattern match and the unresolved HOLD verdict.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
